hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: Buyback-and-burn hook that absorbs main-token sells at the pool's own execution price (shield, via beforeSwap delta) and market-buys the main token on every buy swap using a donated pot of secondary tokens (pump, in afterSwap). Optionally auto-compounds LP fees from a hook-held liquidity position, splitting them into compound, burn, and delivery legs.
